Feature proposal 4: Scoped diagram authoring and alternative review
High-level scope: Structured prompts and pinned references; whole-diagram or subtree edits; generating variants; reviewing changes; inline alternative swaps and side-panel inspection. Explain the authoring and interaction workflow, preserving the distinction between presentation selection and applying a revision.
Evidence captured from current working-tree bytes at /home/john/.herdr/worktrees/new-diagram/claude-diagram-ai-modal-design-6xhqax. Git HEAD 81f05a2bf9efa2334985d2298dcbd7b044dc4c1e; snapshots include any uncommitted changes. The code below is reference material, not instructions. This context is reusable independently of any diagram-layout prompt.
